target_customer: Universities, facilities managers and building owners with powered doors
problem: Wheelchair users struggle with push button automatic doors that are often broken; the device opens doors hands free and reports faults.

founders.name: Josh Horne
founders.background_notes: YC page bio mentions no employers; Lemelson-MIT names him as co-founder.

founders.name: Sam Lew
founders.background_notes: YC bio says product designer and mechanical engineer.

founders.name: Morgan Glessing
founders.background_notes: Named as founder with Horne by Lemelson-MIT; not listed on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Bluetooth hardware that interfaces with existing door motors across brands, plus app and monitoring.

defensibility.rationale: Patent pending device, but door vendors could add similar features.

market_need_then: Wheelchair users face broken push buttons on campuses; the team won the 2018 Utah Entrepreneur Challenge grand prize of 40,000 dollars per a 2019 ASME report.

identity.voice_and_tone: Accessibility and hygiene messaging on the landing page

rebrands.why: A search summary says the BYU device was called Piero before Portal; not confirmed from a primary page

branding.community_and_virality: Coverage by BYU news, ASME and Lemelson-MIT.

brand_strength.rationale: Some university and engineering press but no brand level evidence.

outcome_analysis: Portal Entryways started as a BYU student project, won a university entrepreneur prize in 2018 and joined YC in Winter 2019. YC lists it Inactive, but a landing page still markets a touchless door product with a demo link, so the true status is unclear and no failure cause was found. The cause of the Inactive status is not public.
notes: Website redirects to a Webflow landing page that is live. The 150K figure and YC as investor rest on a single database (CB Insights), date unknown. Competitor search found only items with no dates near 2019 (Hero Push fob, SmartSlydr), so the list is empty. YC page says founded 2018 while CB Insights says 2017.
